published.carries: Main source since v1.3.0; milestone v1.4.0 (V1.4-01 / CONNECT-01 #1295: #1296-#1302, #1286). Every service goes through the Connection and Delegation Contract: one AgentOS decision point for every Claude Code and Codex tool call (#1296); owner introduction and trust records (#1297); mutate and payment-class effects on AI-side connections (#1298), with owner-markable money-capable connections where every non-read call, such as a securities order, needs per-action approval bound to its exact parameters; capability search and connect-in-conversation that continues the original Work after MCP, OAuth, browser or API setup (#1299, #1301); owner-registered API connections by secret-slot reference (#1300). Sandboxed code runs by the owner's AI with owner secret sets, owner-reviewed reads, a saved function library and a state-changing request sent once with exact approval (#1380, #1456, #1486). Approvals answered by reaction or reply with clear-signed messages (#1468-#1501); reservations seen and managed in conversation (#1455); first setup finished in the terminal on agentos start (#1475); the plan chooses worker reasoning effort and keeps Work on the owner's Main AI family (#1431, #1434); outcome-judgment accuracy fixes (#1440, #1445, #1451, #1466); Telegram bot identity and owner-language system lines (#1337, #1350); the Still homepage (#1314). published.carries: Out-of-band patch on v1.4.0; milestone v1.4.1 (#1531, #1532). Intel Macs install again with the one-line installer and the Homebrew formula: cryptography publishes no Intel macOS wheel from 49.0.0, so Intel Macs now resolve cryptography 48.0.1 from its universal2 wheel instead of compiling it, while every other platform keeps the newest release. validate now fails when a supported platform would need a source build. The release workflow now also starts for a release-preparation PR that changes only this manifest, as a patch release shipping the placeholder version does (#1535). No AgentOS runtime code change.
published.observed: Published by the release workflow after owner approval. The served tag archive SHA-256 was measured twice and matched; Homebrew tap PR https://github.com/Jongtae/homebrew-agentos/pull/23 merged after its macOS formula install and brew test passed. The owner's own installed upgrade is not yet recorded.
published.not_claimed: No install on a real Intel Mac was observed before publication; resolution and a wheel-only install of the Intel macOS dependency set were checked with uv platform targeting, and AgentOS crypto tests passed against cryptography 48.0.1 on Apple Silicon. cryptography 48.0.1 on Intel Macs carries GHSA-g6cj-pr64-35w5, GHSA-jwv3-5hgf-82ww and GHSA-m2h6-j472-rp4c in PKCS#7 decryption and the X.509 verifier, which AgentOS does not call. Tests and CI do not prove live external integrations.
